title: What If You Could Never Feel Pain?

scenes.text: What if you could never feel pain? It sounds like a superpower. It isn't.
Some people are really born this way, through a rare condition called congenital insensitivity to pain.
Pain is an alarm. Without it, you can break a bone or burn a hand and never notice.
Young children with the condition bite their mouths and fingers again and again, and suffer repeated burns.
Wounds, bruises and broken bones pile up undetected, and that often shortens life.
Pain isn't the enemy. It's the warning system that keeps you alive.
